objective.statement: Keep repository backups durable without monopolizing host resources or catch-up looping.
objective.measure: Backup and ledger units evaluate with bounded resources and completion-relative timers.

need.statement: The shared devbox backup sweep used eight workers, fixed wall-clock scheduling, no cgroup limits, and unrelated ledger work.
need.baseline: The source used jobs=8 and OnCalendar=*/15 without named service resource limits.
need.consequence_of_no_action: A backup run can contend with operator access and immediately restart after overrunning its interval.
assumptions: Home Manager owns these user units.

purpose: Bound backup resource consumption while retaining repository and dirty jj-workspace durability.
consumer: The cc-se-sto-devbox-01 operator and git-auto-backup systemd user unit.
contract: The backup runs with two workers, low CPU/I/O priority, named memory limits, starts five minutes after timer activation, waits fifteen minutes after completion, writes only refs/backup with hooks bypassed, and moves ledger preservation to a separate low-priority hourly completion-relative unit.
failure_boundary: A constrained run may take longer, but no repository or dirty jj-workspace class may be silently removed from backup coverage.

evidence.description: scripts/test-nix-tooling.mjs asserts the timer, concurrency, resource properties, and removed hot-path work.

falsifier.claim: The generated configuration contains every guardrail without workspace-ledger work.

non_goals: Changing infra-owned alerts, watchdogs, or sshd priority
invariants: Dirty Git state remains backed up
Non-default jj workspaces remain backed up
Backup writes never publish live branches
Workspace ownership records remain preserved outside volatile storage

assumptions.statement: Home Manager maps the named systemd service properties to the intended user unit.
assumptions.falsifier: Activation-package evaluation or generated-unit inspection omits or changes a property.

plane_constraints: Home Manager owns the user units.
